summary: Unitil Corp filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 4 to its Purchase and Sale Agreement with Aquarion Water Authority, changing the acquisition scope from three subsidiaries (AWC-MA, AWC-NH, Abenaki) to only AWC-NH and Abenaki, effectively narrowing the deal. The prior amendments extended the termination date to June 30, 2026. No financial terms, price/share, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed in this excerpt. The filing includes an Operating and Transition Services Agreement. Watch for regulatory approvals and any further adjustments as the revised transaction proceeds toward close.
